text:
Collections
What Papyrus collections are and how folder-backed collection routes work.
A collection is a folder of posts with a TOML file. Use one when readers should follow posts in a fixed order instead of normal blog date order. The same Markdown post can appear in the regular `/posts/` archive and in a collection route. The archive sorts by publishing metadata;
